title: Perplexity Pro Search has turned to garbage seemingly overnight
summary: Example https://www.perplexity.ai/search/has-there-been-any-criticism-o-mc4XqbveR9uAduiTfyZJTw My query above should be what Perplexity Pro Search is best at. Perplexity was really good at this just a couple of weeks ago. It's become a terrible, frustrating experience. I'm a Pro subscriber and I'll have to stop using this service altogether if it can't have a continuous research conversation with me. It gives overly short answers to questions which clearly are begging for long, detailed answers, forcing me to ask for it...see the first handful of back and forths in my example Refuses to attempt internet research and instead asks ME to do it! ("you might explore...on platforms like youtube for related discussions.") Bro, YOU do it! That's why you exist! Sometimes does not do what I ask WITHOUT an intervening output. ("OK, do you have access to the text of any other critique of the Credo 2023 report" "Yes, there are critiques of the CREDO 2023 report [followed by not discussing its access]". I can't be the only one who has this problem. This worked great a couple weeks ago. I sure hope this isn't a result of Perplexity deciding to throttle its model to save a few bucks. submitted by /u/throwaway867530691 [link] [comments]
